topic: Demand Generation and Content Marketing Strategy
headline: Video & Visual Content
keyNotes: Even with new tools like Artificial Intelligence (AI) that can create images, the article suggests it's important to make sure these visuals don't look obviously "AI Made This" and still reflect a brand's unique style.
Businesses selling to other businesses (B2B) are finding success with video, even using short, engaging stories called "microdramas" which were traditionally popular with consumer brands.

Engaging customers with interactive content, like quizzes, games, and polls, can make a big difference; one brand even used quizzes to reduce "churn" (when customers stop using their service) and win awards.

Telling compelling stories through visuals and video is a powerful way for brands to connect with people, with examples like "Visit Myrtle Beach" leading a new era of marketing by focusing on storytelling.
question: The article shows how even a "mundane announcement" from the NFL can become "must-see videos" through creative visual content. Thinking about your own work, what seemingly ordinary information or process could you transform into an engaging visual story or interactive experience for your audience?
